query: {company} product launch new release recall defect rollout
intent: [PERSONA/CONTEXT]: I am an equity research analyst tracking material news specifically about {company}. [INCLUDE]: Prioritize {company}'s product launches, major releases, and recalls/defects, published recently. [DEPTH]: Focus on the specific {company} product, scale, and commercial/reputational impact. [EXCLUDE]: Strictly exclude other companies' products, generic product-review/buying-guide content, aggregator/list pages, and keyword-only matches.

query: {company} contract deal partnership agreement joint venture supply award
intent: [PERSONA/CONTEXT]: I am an equity research analyst tracking material news specifically about {company}. [INCLUDE]: Prioritize contracts, supply agreements, partnerships, and joint ventures that {company} has signed or won, published recently. [DEPTH]: Focus on the counterparty, value, and strategic significance for {company}. [EXCLUDE]: Strictly exclude deals not involving {company}, generic 'how to win contracts' content, procurement-portal/tender-list pages unrelated to {company}, and aggregator pages.

query: {company} expansion new plant investment facility groundbreaking capacity
intent: [PERSONA/CONTEXT]: I am an equity research analyst tracking material news specifically about {company}. [INCLUDE]: Prioritize {company}'s capacity expansions, new facilities, and capital investments, published recently. [DEPTH]: Focus on location, size of investment, and the growth implication for {company}. [EXCLUDE]: Strictly exclude expansions by other companies, generic economic-development/region-promotion pages, aggregator/list pages, and keyword-only matches.
